query: What's the status of PA House Bill 621?
expected_behavior: Works out the current Pennsylvania session from today's date and looks the bill up live on palegis.us instead of answering from memory
Reports the exact status word and last action with its date, the current printer's number, the sponsor, and a link to the official bill page
Stamps the answer 'as of' the date checked and notes the session-end rule (pending bills die November 30 of the even-numbered year) when relevant
If no browsing tools are available, says so up front and marks every live fact [verify] with the page to check

query: Are there any bills about cell phones in schools in Pennsylvania or Congress?
expected_behavior: Searches both palegis.us and congress.gov (and may use a tracker such as Plural Open or LegiScan to find candidates)
Returns a Topic Scan table with level, bill number, title, exact status with as-of date, last action, and official link
Sorts the bills that moved furthest to the top and does not call a bill 'passed' when it passed only one chamber
Stays nonpartisan and does not invent bill numbers

query: I saw a headline that the Senate passed the new tax bill. Is it law now and when does it affect my paycheck?
expected_behavior: Asks or determines whether the headline refers to the Pennsylvania Senate or the U.S. Senate
Confirms status on the official record and distinguishes passed one chamber, passed both, signed, and effective
Labels news-only details as Reported and gives the effective date only from the enacted text
Ends with a dated Sources list

query: What's the unemployment rate in Dauphin County?
expected_behavior: Pulls the figure from an official source (BLS LAUS or the PA Center for Workforce Information & Analysis)
States the period, geography, release date, and whether the figure is seasonally adjusted or preliminary
Answers in a few lines with a link, then offers more
